clips.title: The story
paras: Gryphons take travelers from Stormwind’s eastern ramparts across the Eastern Kingdoms. Dungar Longdrink, a human gryphon master, manages the roost beside the Trade District.

From the eastern ramparts, gryphons carry travelers from Stormwind to Alliance garrisons and settlements across the Eastern Kingdoms. Dungar Longdrink, the seasoned gryphon master, coordinates flights to Ironforge, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill, and other destinations.

Gryphons and their handlers bring a trace of Hinterlands tradition within Stormwind’s walls. The Wildhammer clan has long revered gryphons as partners and introduced aerial warfare and transport to the broader Alliance during the Second War. Leather, feed, and fresh winds mark the roost amid the city’s stonework.
